Usage: headroom check [flags]

Verify the vendor facts headroom relies on, and its own state.

Verifies the reverse-engineered vendor facts headroom relies on — credential, identity and
usage-response shapes, the binary's seams, the session store's topology and retention —
and headroom's own state, for every vendor on this machine. Run it after a Claude Code or
Codex update, or when the board looks wrong. One line per assertion: ok, FAIL, or ?? for
one it could not test (rate limited, offline, a stale token). It exits 0 when everything
passed, 1 on any FAIL — a configuration headroom refuses among them — and 2 when nothing
failed but something could not be tested.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help       Show context-sensitive help.
      --version    Print the build this binary is — its commit and the commit's time — and exit.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments, nothing was run; for check, an assertion it could not test (INCONCLUSIVE)
  3    headless place refused: every account it could take is near a limit or excluded; login start,
       finish or cancel refused, nothing spent or sent: the document's reason says why
